name: metrics-report
description: Analyzes and reports on pipeline metrics collected by MetricsCollector during cargo-cicd execution. Extracts stage latencies (p50, p90, p99, mean, max), generates formatted performance reports, and tracks trends over time.
author: cargo-cicd metrics integration

parameters.name: output_format
parameters.description: Output format for the metrics report: 'text' for human-readable tables, 'json' for programmatic consumption, 'html' for styled browser-viewable reports

parameters.name: compare_to
parameters.description: Path to a previous metrics JSON file for trend analysis and regression detection. Computes percentage deltas and marks regressions (>10% slower) vs baseline.

parameters.name: save_to
parameters.description: File path where the metrics report will be persisted as JSON for historical tracking and trend analysis over time.

parameters.name: threshold_ms
parameters.description: Alert threshold in milliseconds. Any stage's p99 latency exceeding this will be flagged as 'threshold_exceeded' in recommendations. Default 5000ms (5s).

parameters.name: log_level
parameters.description: RUST_LOG level for capturing internal tracing/metrics output. Use 'debug' for detailed metrics, 'info' for standard metrics collection, 'trace' for verbose diagnostics.

parameters.name: show_histogram_data
parameters.description: Include detailed histogram bucket breakdown in JSON output for advanced analysis. Increases output size significantly.

command.description: Execute cargo-cicd pipeline with metrics collection enabled, capture histogram data from MetricsCollector, aggregate percentiles, and generate performance reports

execution.description: Full command pipeline with output capture and post-processing
execution.shell_script:
set -e echo '[metrics-report] Starting metrics collection with log_level=${log_level}...' export RUST_LOG="${log_level}" export RUST_BACKTRACE=1 # Create temp directory for intermediate files METRICS_TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d -t metrics-XXXXXX) echo "[metrics-report] Working directory: ${METRICS_TMPDIR}" trp 'rm -rf ${METRICS_TMPDIR}' EXIT # Step 1: Run cargo-cicd with advanced features and capture output echo '[metrics-report] Running cargo-cicd with --features advanced...' METRICS_LOG="${METRICS_TMPDIR}/pipeline.log" cargo run --quiet --features advanced 2>&1 | tee "${METRICS_LOG}" || echo '[metrics-report] WARNING: Pipeline execution may have failed' >&2 echo '[metrics-report] ✓ Pipeline execution complete. Output captured to ${METRICS_LOG}' # Step 2: Extract structured metric events using Python regex parser echo '[metrics-report] Parsing structured metrics from output...' PARSE_SCRIPT="${METRICS_TMPDIR}/parse.py" cat > "${PARSE_SCRIPT}" << 'PARSE_EOF' import re, json, sys from datetime import datetime metrics = {} with open(sys.argv[1]) as f: for line in f: # Pattern: stage_name: p50=XXXXµs, p90=XXXXµs, p99=XXXXµs m = re.search(r'([a-z_]+):\s+p50=([0-9]+)µs,\s+p90=([0-9]+)µs,\s+p99=([0-9]+)µs', line) if m: name, p50, p90, p99 = m.groups() # Extract optional count, mean, max count = int(re.search(r'count=([0-9]+)', line).group(1) or 1) if 'count=' in line else 1 mean = float(re.search(r'mean=([0-9.]+)µs', line).group(1) or p50) if 'mean=' in line else float(p50) maxx = int(re.search(r'max=([0-9]+)µs', line).group(1) or p99) if 'max=' in line else int(p99) metrics[name] = {'p50_us':int(p50), 'p90_us':int(p90), 'p99_us':int(p99), 'count':count, 'mean_us':mean, 'max_us':maxx} result = {'timestamp': datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+'Z', 'stages': metrics} print(json.dumps(result, indent=2)) PARSE_EOF RAW_METRICS="${METRICS_TMPDIR}/metrics_raw.json" python3 "${PARSE_SCRIPT}" "${METRICS_LOG}" > "${RAW_METRICS}" echo '[metrics-report] ✓ Metrics extraction complete' # Step 3: Generate comprehensive report with statistics and recommendations echo '[metrics-report] Generating report with statistics and recommendations...' REPORT_SCRIPT="${METRICS_TMPDIR}/report.py" cat > "${REPORT_SCRIPT}" << 'REPORT_EOF' import json, sys from datetime import datetime with open(sys.argv[1]) as f: current = json.load(f) stages = [(n, d) for n, d in current['stages'].items()] stages.sort(key=lambda x: x[1]['p99_us'], reverse=True) stage_list = [] for name, data in stages: stage_list.append({ 'name': name, 'count': data['count'], 'p50_ms': round(data['p50_us']/1000, 3), 'p90_ms': round(data['p90_us']/1000, 3), 'p99_ms': round(data['p99_us']/1000, 3), 'mean_ms': round(data['mean_us']/1000, 3), 'max_ms': round(data['max_us']/1000, 3), 'p50_us': data['p50_us'], 'p90_us': data['p90_us'], 'p99_us': data['p99_us'], 'mean_us': data['mean_us'], 'max_us': data['max_us'], }) threshold_ms = float(sys.argv[2] or 5000) baseline_path = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 and sys.argv[3] != 'null' else None baseline = None if baseline_path: try: with open(baseline_path) as f: baseline = json.load(f) except: print(f'[metrics-report] WARNING: Could not load baseline {baseline_path}', file=sys.stderr) summary = { 'total_stages': len(stage_list), 'total_time_ms': round(sum(s['mean_ms'] for s in stage_list), 3), 'slowest_stage': stage_list[0]['name'] if stage_list else None, 'slowest_stage_p99_ms': stage_list[0]['p99_ms'] if stage_list else None, 'fastest_stage': stage_list[-1]['name'] if stage_list else None, 'fastest_stage_p99_ms': stage_list[-1]['p99_ms'] if stage_list else None, } recs = [] for stage in stage_list: if stage['p99_ms'] > threshold_ms: recs.append({'type': 'threshold_exceeded', 'stage': stage['name'], 'severity': 'warning', 'message': f"p99={stage['p99_ms']:.1f}ms exceeds {threshold_ms}ms", 'suggested_action': f"Investigate {stage['name']}"}) if len(stage_list) > 1: median = sorted([s['p99_ms'] for s in stage_list])[len(stage_list)//2] for stage in stage_list: if stage['p99_ms'] > median * 3: recs.append({'type': 'performance_hotspot', 'stage': stage['name'], 'severity': 'critical', 'message': f"{stage['p99_ms']/median:.1f}x slower than median", 'suggested_action': f"Profile and optimize {stage['name']}"}) if stage['p50_ms'] > 0 and stage['p99_ms']/stage['p50_ms'] > 5: recs.append({'type': 'high_variance', 'stage': stage['name'], 'severity': 'info', 'message': f"p99/p50={stage['p99_ms']/stage['p50_ms']:.1f}x variance", 'suggested_action': f"Investigate latency variance in {stage['name']}"}) comparison = None if baseline: comparison = {'compared_to': baseline_path, 'comparison_timestamp': baseline.get('timestamp'), 'stages': []} baseline_stages = {s['name']: s for s in baseline.get('stages', [])} for stage in stage_list: if stage['name'] in baseline_stages: b = baseline_stages[stage['name']] p50_chg = ((stage['p50_ms'] - b['p50_ms']) / b['p50_ms'] * 100) if b['p50_ms'] > 0 else 0 p90_chg = ((stage['p90_ms'] - b['p90_ms']) / b['p90_ms'] * 100) if b['p90_ms'] > 0 else 0 p99_chg = ((stage['p99_ms'] - b['p99_ms']) / b['p99_ms'] * 100) if b['p99_ms'] > 0 else 0 is_reg = stage['p99_ms'] > b['p99_ms'] * 1.1 status = 'degraded' if is_reg else ('improved' if p99_chg < -5 else 'stable') comparison['stages'].append({ 'name': stage['name'], 'p50_change_percent': round(p50_chg, 2), 'p90_change_percent': round(p90_chg, 2), 'p99_change_percent': round(p99_chg, 2), 'regression': is_reg, 'direction': status }) if is_reg: recs.append({'type': 'regression_detected', 'stage': stage['name'], 'severity': 'warning', 'message': f"p99 {p99_chg:+.1f}% vs baseline", 'suggested_action': f"Review recent changes to {stage['name']}"}) report = { 'metadata': {'timestamp': datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+'Z', 'stages_collected': len(stage_list), 'threshold_ms': threshold_ms}, 'stages': stage_list, 'summary': summary, 'recommendations': recs } if comparison: report['baseline_comparison'] = comparison print(json.dumps(report, indent=2)) REPORT_EOF FINAL_REPORT="${METRICS_TMPDIR}/report.json" python3 "${REPORT_SCRIPT}" "${RAW_METRICS}" "${threshold_ms}" "${compare_to}" > "${FINAL_REPORT}" echo '[metrics-report] ✓ Report generation complete' # Step 4: Format and output report in requested format echo '[metrics-report] Formatting output as ${output_format}...' case "${output_format}" in json) cat "${FINAL_REPORT}" if [ -n "${save_to}" ] && [ "${save_to}" != "null" ]; then mkdir -p "$(dirname ${save_to})" cp "${FINAL_REPORT}" "${save_to}" echo "" >&2 echo "[metrics-report] ✓ Report saved to ${save_to}" >&2 fi ;; text) python3 <<'TEXT_EOF' "${FINAL_REPORT}" import json, sys with open(sys.argv[1]) as f: d=json.load(f) print(f"\n=== CARGO-CICD Metrics Report ===") print(f"Generated: {d['metadata']['timestamp']}") print(f"\n--- Per-Stage Statistics (sorted by p99) ---") print(f"{'Stage':<15} {'Count':>8} {'p50(ms)':>10} {'p90(ms)':>10} {'p99(ms)':>10} {'Mean(ms)':>10} {'Max(ms)':>10}") print("-" * 75) for s in d['stages']: print(f"{s['name']:<15} {s['count']:>8} {s['p50_ms']:>10.3f} {s['p90_ms']:>10.3f} {s['p99_ms']:>10.3f} {s['mean_ms']:>10.3f} {s['max_ms']:>10.3f}") print(f"\n--- Summary ---") sum_d = d['summary'] print(f"Total Stages: {sum_d['total_stages']}") print(f"Total Pipeline Time: {sum_d['total_time_ms']:.3f}ms") print(f"Slowest Stage: {sum_d['slowest_stage']} (p99={sum_d['slowest_stage_p99_ms']:.3f}ms)") print(f"Fastest Stage: {sum_d['fastest_stage']} (p99={sum_d['fastest_stage_p99_ms']:.3f}ms)") if 'baseline_comparison' in d: print(f"\n--- Baseline Comparison ---") print(f"Compared to: {d['baseline_comparison']['compared_to']}") print(f"{'Stage':<15} {'p50 Δ%':>10} {'p90 Δ%':>10} {'p99 Δ%':>10} {'Status':>12}") print("-" * 57) for s in d['baseline_comparison']['stages']: status = 'REGRESSION' if s['regression'] else s['direction'].upper() print(f"{s['name']:<15} {s['p50_change_percent']:>10.1f} {s['p90_change_percent']:>10.1f} {s['p99_change_percent']:>10.1f} {status:>12}") if d['recommendations']: print(f"\n--- Recommendations ---") for r in d['recommendations']: print(f"[{r['severity'].upper()}] {r['type'].replace('_', ' ').title()}") print(f" Stage: {r['stage']}") print(f" Message: {r['message']}") print(f" Action: {r['suggested_action']}") TEXT_EOF ;; html) python3 <<'HTML_EOF' "${FINAL_REPORT}" "${save_to}" import json, sys with open(sys.argv[1]) as f: d=json.load(f) html=f""" Metrics Report

📊 Metrics Report - cargo-cicd

Generated: {d['metadata']['timestamp']} | Stages: {d['metadata']['stages_collected']} | Threshold: {d['metadata']['threshold_ms']}ms

Per-Stage Statistics

""" for s in d['stages']: bg = ' style="background: #ffe6e6;"' if s['p99_ms'] > d['metadata']['threshold_ms'] else (' style="background: #fff9e6;"' if s['p99_ms'] > d['metadata']['threshold_ms'] * 0.5 else '') html += f"\n" html += "
StageCountp50 (ms)p90 (ms)p99 (ms)Mean (ms)Max (ms)
{s['name']}{s['count']}{s['p50_ms']:.3f}{s['p90_ms']:.3f}{s['p99_ms']:.3f}{s['mean_ms']:.3f}{s['max_ms']:.3f}
\n" if 'baseline_comparison' in d: html += f"

Baseline Comparison

\n\n" for s in d['baseline_comparison']['stages']: status_class = f"status-{s['direction']}" html += f"\n" html += "
Stagep50 Δ%p90 Δ%p99 Δ%Status
{s['name']}{s['p50_change_percent']:+.1f}{s['p90_change_percent']:+.1f}{s['p99_change_percent']:+.1f}{s['direction'].upper()}

steps.name: setup_environment
steps.description: Configure Rust logging and create temporary working directory for intermediate files

steps.name: run_pipeline
steps.description: Execute cargo-cicd with advanced feature enabled to enable MetricsCollector and capture tracing output

steps.name: extract_metrics
steps.description: Parse histogram data from MetricsCollector output using regex pattern matching on stage metric lines

steps.name: aggregate_histograms
steps.description: Convert microsecond measurements to milliseconds, calculate summary statistics (total, slowest, fastest)

steps.name: calculate_deltas
steps.description: If compare_to baseline provided, compute percentage changes and detect regressions (>10% slower)

steps.name: generate_report
steps.description: Build comprehensive report with per-stage metrics, summary stats, and actionable recommendations

steps.name: generate_recommendations
steps.description: Analyze metrics and produce recommendations: threshold_exceeded, performance_hotspot, high_variance, regression_detected

steps.name: format_output
steps.description: Render report in requested format (text table, JSON object, or standalone HTML)

steps.name: save_report
steps.description: Persist report to file if save_to parameter provided, creating parent directories as needed

parse_metrics_output.description: Extract stage latency metrics from MetricsCollector.report() output by parsing tracing logs. MetricsCollector emits one line per stage in format: 'stage_name: p50=XXXXµs, p90=XXXXµs, p99=XXXXµs'
parse_metrics_output.input: stdout from 'cargo run --features advanced' - contains tracing output from RUST_LOG
parse_metrics_output.implementation: Use regex to extract stage name and percentile values (mandatory), plus optional count, mean, max fields. Convert all values from microseconds to internal representation. Aggregate multiple occurrences of same stage by merging histograms.

stage_events.count: integer - number of samples recorded in histogram
stage_events.max_us: integer - maximum recorded value in microseconds

aggregate_stage_metrics.description: Compute aggregate statistics for each stage from histogram data. Sort stages by p99 latency descending to highlight bottlenecks. Calculate summary metrics.
aggregate_stage_metrics.logic: For each unique stage name from parsed metrics: convert p50/p90/p99/mean/max from microseconds to milliseconds. Preserve original microsecond values for detailed analysis. Sort stages by p99_ms descending. Calculate total_pipeline_ms (sum of means), identify slowest (highest p99) and fastest (lowest p99) stages.
edge_cases: If count=0 for a stage, mark as no-data
If mean is absent, estimate from p50
If only p99 is available (count=1), use p99 as p50/p90 proxy

stages.name: string - stage name (e.g., 'scan', 'test', 'publish')
stages.mean_ms: number - arithmetic mean latency in milliseconds
stages.max_ms: number - maximum recorded latency in milliseconds
stages.p50_us: integer - median latency in microseconds (preserved for detail)

summary.total_stages: integer - count of unique stages with metrics
summary.total_time_ms: number - sum of mean latencies across all stages (approximation of total pipeline time)
summary.slowest_stage: string - stage name with highest p99 latency
summary.slowest_stage_p99_ms: number - p99 of slowest stage in milliseconds
summary.fastest_stage: string - stage name with lowest p99 latency
summary.fastest_stage_p99_ms: number - p99 of fastest stage in milliseconds
summary.total_measurements: integer - sum of count across all stages

calculate_trend_deltas.description: Compare current metrics to previous baseline file. Load baseline JSON, match stages by name, compute percentage deltas, and identify regressions vs improvements.
calculate_trend_deltas.logic: For each stage in current metrics: (1) lookup stage in baseline by name; (2) compute delta_pct = (current - baseline) / baseline * 100 for p50, p90, p99; (3) mark as regression if p99_delta_pct > +10%, improved if < -10%, stable otherwise; (4) emit comparison records with delta percentages and direction.
calculate_trend_deltas.file_format: Baseline file is JSON export from prior run with structure: {stages: [{name, p50_ms, p90_ms, p99_ms, ...}], timestamp, ...}
calculate_trend_deltas.regression_threshold: 10% - if current p99 > baseline p99 * 1.10, flag as regression
calculate_trend_deltas.improvement_threshold: -10% - if current p99 < baseline p99 * 0.90, flag as improved

input.current_metrics: aggregated metrics from current run with stage_list

trends.p50_delta_pct: number - percent change since baseline (negative=faster, positive=slower)
trends.p99_delta_pct: number - percent change since baseline (primary metric for regression detection)
trends.previous_p50_ms: number - baseline p50 from previous run
trends.previous_p99_ms: number - baseline p99 from previous run

format_report.description: Render aggregated metrics in requested output format. Each format is self-contained (text is readable as-is, JSON is parseable, HTML is viewable in browsers)

text.description: Human-readable text report with aligned columns, suitable for terminal output and logs
features: Header with timestamp and stage count
Per-stage table sorted by p99 descending (slowest first)
Columns: Stage, Count, p50(ms), p90(ms), p99(ms), Mean(ms), Max(ms)
Summary section: total stages, total time, slowest/fastest stage names and values
Baseline comparison table (if compare_to provided): Stage, p50Δ%, p90Δ%, p99Δ%, Status
Recommendations section with [SEVERITY] prefix for each item

json.description: Structured JSON for programmatic consumption, persistence, and historical comparison. Suitable for piping to jq, storing in databases, or loading as baseline for future runs.

metadata.timestamp: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of report generation
metadata.stages_collected: count of unique stages with metrics
metadata.threshold_ms: alert threshold used during report generation

html.description: Standalone HTML document with embedded CSS and responsive design. Self-contained (no external dependencies) and viewable in any modern browser. Suitable for sharing reports and archiving.
features: Header with execution metadata (timestamp, stage count, threshold)
Summary cards: Total Stages, Total Time, Slowest Stage, Fastest Stage
Per-stage metrics table with color coding (green <50% threshold, yellow 50-100%, red >100%)
Baseline comparison table if available (status indicators: IMPROVED/STABLE/DEGRADED/REGRESSION)
Inline CSS for styling (no external stylesheets required)
sections: Page header with title and execution metadata
Summary box grid (4 cards) showing key metrics
Per-stage statistics table (sorted by p99 descending)

persist_report.logic: Format report as JSON (regardless of output_format parameter) and write to save_to path. Create parent directories if needed. Overwrite existing file.

success.description: Whether metrics collection and report generation succeeded

trends.description: Present only if compare_to was provided

stage.description: Stage name if specific to one stage

saved_to.description: File path if save_to parameter was provided and report was persisted

errors.description: Any errors encountered during metrics collection or report generation

notes.architecture: MetricsCollector (src/integrations/metrics_collector.rs) wraps StageLatencies (src/advanced/histogram.rs) which uses HdrHistogram for accurate percentile tracking. Each stage records latencies in microseconds (range: 1µs to 60s) at 3 significant figures precision.
notes.metric_units: Internal metrics use microseconds; reports display milliseconds for readability
integration_points: MetricsCollector::record_stage(stage_name, micros) - invoked by instrumented pipeline code
notes.performance_impact: Minimal - HdrHistogram uses fixed small memory footprint (~32KB per stage histogram). Thread-safe merge() allows parallel collection.
future_extensions: XES (XML Event Stream) format for wasm4pm evidence integration
Prometheus metrics export for monitoring dashboards
Percentile heatmaps for visualizing latency distributions
Anomaly detection and automatic outlier flagging
Budget-based alerts (e.g., 'test stage should complete in <500ms')

exit_codes.0: Metrics collection and report generation succeeded
exit_codes.1: Pipeline execution failed or metrics collection error
exit_codes.3: Output file could not be written
exit_codes.4: Comparison file (compare_to) not found or invalid
